registryEntry.get_command: Get-MgPolicyAuthenticationStrengthPolicy -All | Where-Object { ($_.DisplayName -eq 'CMMC-PhishingResistant') -or ((@($_.AllowedCombinations | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -gt 0 -and @($_.AllowedCombinations | Where-Object { @('fido2','windowsHelloForBusiness','x509CertificateMultiFactor') -notcontains $_ }).Count -eq 0)) } | Sort-Object { $_.DisplayName -ne 'CMMC-PhishingResistant' } | Select-Object -First 1 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
